title.en: stand-up open mic at lazy fox.

line.en: helsinki stand-up league's monthly open mic, in english, 19:00 to 21:00 at lazy fox kamppi. free entry, 18 and over, for women and lgbtq+ comedians of all levels.
line.de: der monatliche open mic der helsinki stand-up league, auf englisch, 19:00 bis 21:00 im lazy fox kamppi. eintritt frei, ab 18 jahren, für comedians aller stufen, besonders frauen und lgbtq+.
line.tr: helsinki stand-up league'in aylık open mic'i, ingilizce, 19:00 - 21:00 arası lazy fox kamppi'de. giriş ücretsiz, 18 yaş ve üstü; her seviyeden kadın ve lgbtq+ komedyenler için.
